message.tears-of-ink.contract_signed: The contract is signed. The ink waters call you; the dim mirror beckons you to look into it…

guide.tears-of-ink.mirror_vestibule: Not now, little one. The gate is right in front of you.
letter.tears-of-ink.invitation:
Dear guest!

You are invited to the Ink Lands — a land of fog, blood and ink, where every hope has its price.

Sign, and the dim mirror will open the way. There will be no way back… almost.

With deepest respect,
Mister Guide
diary.tears-of-ink.title: Diary
diary.tears-of-ink.empty: The pages are empty. For now.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.1: Ah, there you are, little one. Welcome to the Threshold.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.2: Beyond the gate lie the Ink Lands. Fog, blood and ink… and a little hope, if you're lucky.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.3: The contract is signed, so you have a way home — the mirror. Take care of it, my friend. It takes care of you too.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.4: Here, take this. Everything you need to begin.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.5: Enjoy your stay, little one. Savor this adventure.
message.tears-of-ink.diary_new: A new entry seeps through the diary's pages…
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.first_steps.tex: Look around the Ink Lands. You can start with the nearest temple and fountain, explore the Pale Forest, gather materials and investigate ruins. Choose your own path: new discoveries will add knowledge to the diary.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_metal.text: Pale ore can be found in the Pale Forest. Raw pale metal can be smelted into ingots in a furnace or blast furnace. Pale ingots are used to make weapons and other equipment.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.fountain_hunt.t: Drink from an Ink Fountain: the first sip from a new fountain increases your Ink capacity. After drinking, crouch and use Shift + right-click on that fountain to summon the Soul Trader. Her board offers Hunt contracts. Complete one and return the Fulfilled Contract to her for Pigment. Pigment is used in forging, sharpening and ascending weapons.
You do not find a ready-made Ascension Font: you build it. Make a 5×5 base. Place a 3×3 pool of water in the center, with scarlet wood beneath all nine water blocks. Around the water, at the same level, build a ring of 16 pale wood blocks. At each of its four corners, place a two-block-high scarlet wood pillar on top. Stand in the center of the water, hold your weapon and use Shift + right-click. Ascending to Contrast costs 8 Pigment and one rare resource of the weapon's line; reaching Rubric costs 16 Pigment and two. Spire weapons need Sigils of Valor, Blood weapons Crimson Flowers, and Ink weapons Motes of Hope. An incomplete Font highlights missing parts.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.intro.title: Кто бы ты ни был
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.intro.text: Если ты читаешь это — значит, он встретил и тебя. Я тоже подписал. Я тоже думал, что зеркальце — это путь домой. Пиши, когда узнаешь что-то. Я буду писать за тебя, если не успеешь.

vow.tears-of-ink.choose.title: Vow
vow.tears-of-ink.choose.text: The contract is signed, but one clause remains. Beyond the gate everyone walks their own road — and the road decides what you become.
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.name: Path of Ink
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.short: The Fountain's power in your veins.
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.text: The Fountain's Ink will take you in. Black books will open, the Ink Hearts of the fallen will answer your call. But Ink is a foreign power: the more of it in you, the less of you remains.
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.name: Path of Soul
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.short: Your own power, granted by no one.
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.text: You will walk with what is already yours. White books will open, and your Soul will awaken through your deeds. Ink Hearts will stay silent: one who chose the light cannot hear their call.
vow.tears-of-ink.book_blurred: The lines blur. This path is not for you.
vow.tears-of-ink.skill_asleep: "%s" sleeps: it belongs to another path.
vow.tears-of-ink.book_other: The lines blur. This path is not for you.

vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_1: First medium contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_2: First hard contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.

guide.tears-of-ink.vow.chosen.soul: The Path of Soul. A rare choice in these parts. Guard your light — it can be seen from afar.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.gate: Not so fast. The gate will not let through one who has taken no vow.

trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_sold: You have already sold part of your soul. Return it first — through Atonement.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_limit: There is nothing more I can take. Your Soul will find the rest on its own.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_ink: There is too little Ink in you — I will not take the last of it.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchanged: The Ink leaves, the Soul unfolds. Soul: %s, Ink reserve: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.unexchanged: You give back what you traded for. Not all of it returns. Soul: %s, Ink reserve: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.sell.unexchange: Your Soul is higher than you were born with — that is my work. I will take the exchange back, but return less Ink.
trader.tears-of-ink.vow.text: Your vow: %s. Do you wish to turn onto another road — %s?
trader.tears-of-ink.vow.sleep: Skills of your former path will fall asleep. They wake if you return.
trader.tears-of-ink.vow.no_pigment: Changing the vow costs %s Pigment. You don't have that much.

trader.tears-of-ink.vow.changed.soul: Vow changed: Path of Soul. Guard your light.
item.tears-of-ink.skill_book_ink_jump.de: Ink pushes off the void itself.

item.tears-of-ink.dim_scimitar.desc2: Wave (R): weaker and costlier than a true scimitar's.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.ask: Before I hand you what is due — tell me which road you will take.

item.tears-of-ink.pale_greatsword.desc1: Spire · common, two-handed. Faster than other heavies.

item.tears-of-ink.blood_greatsword.desc1: Blood · common, two-handed. Sometimes draws blood.

item.tears-of-ink.ink_greatsword.desc1: Ink · common, two-handed. Hits slow the foe.
gear.tears-of-ink.dull: %s is dulling — sharpen it with Pigment at an Ink Anvil.
gear.tears-of-ink.degraded: %s went dull and fell to %s. That tier's properties sleep.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.pale_ore: Found underground in the Pale Forest (Y 0–72). A stone pickaxe is enough. Drops Raw Pale Metal.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_pale_metal: From Pale Ore and pale Spire soldiers. Smelt into a Pale Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_ore: Found shallow under Bloodwood valleys (Y 10–60). Needs an iron pickaxe. Drops Raw Blood Metal.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_blood_metal: From Blood Ore. Smelt into a Blood Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_ink_metal: No ore: sometimes dropped by foes slain in the Inkwood, and found in deep ruin chests. Smelt into an Ink Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink_anvil: Forges hunter weapons in a 3×3 grid. Also sharpening: a Contrast or Rubric weapon plus Pigment, one per slot; each restores a quarter of the edge.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.pigment: The main forging currency: sharpening, ink weapons, tier ascension, changing vows. The Soul Trader pays it for Fulfilled Contracts.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.asphoda: Mined from asphoda ore anywhere underground; found in chests. Used in hunter weapons and stations.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_clot: From blood caterpillars and the Blood Collector tank. Blood weapon material.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink: From ink caterpillars. Spire weapon and Ink Anvil material.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.fulfilled_contract: Reward for a Hunt contract. The Soul Trader pays Pigment for it and may give the hunter's weapon.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.cursed_altar: Weapon awakenings. Place a weapon and a reagent (blood clots — Blood property, ink — Ink property), pick a slot, press Awaken. The result only sticks after Keep; Again rerolls, each costlier. A Blood Crystal or Ink Echo raises a property of its line by one level (III only this way). Slots: Dim 1, Contrast 2, Rubric 3, common weapons 1. Foreign line works at 60%.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.madness_shard: From Ink hunters: 1–2 per contract with an Ink hunter, 2–3 for slaying one yourself. Used for the Cursed Altar.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink_echo: Rarely dropped by foes slain in the Inkwood. Raises an ink property by one level at the Cursed Altar.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_crystal: Rarely forms in the Blood Collector tank. Raises a blood property by one level at the Cursed Altar.
font.tears-of-ink.incomplete: The Font is incomplete: %s missing — places highlighted.
font.tears-of-ink.sigil: The Spire acknowledges your valor: Sigil of Valor.
font.tears-of-ink.sigil_progress: Points toward a Sigil of Valor: %s of %s.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.valor_sigil:
Spire — from Hunt contracts: medium 1 point, hard 2; a Sigil per 8 points. Ascends Spire weapons in the Font.

Ascension Font — a build with a 5×5 base, 4 layers: blood wood at the bottom; on it, 3×3 water in the centre, a pale ring around the water (planks, stairs, slabs — any pale wood); blood wood pillars 2 high at the ring corners. Stair facing and decorations don't matter. Stand in the centre of the water: the Font awakens (black water — Path of Ink, white — Path of Soul). Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.crimson_flower:
Blood — reward of the Crimson Harvest (Arena, later); for now — 25% from a medium or hard contract with a Blood hunter. Ascends Blood weapons in the Font.

Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.hope_mote:
Ink — from the Soul Trader's special orders (later). Ascends Ink weapons in the Font.

Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.

trader.tears-of-ink.option.order_wait: No special orders yet (%s more min)

order.tears-of-ink.taken: One of ours has lost himself. %s roams not far from here — the beam will guide you. Set him free.
order.tears-of-ink.done: %s is at peace. Take what is left of him.
order.tears-of-ink.timeout: The maddened one wandered too far. The order burned out.
order.tears-of-ink.abandoned: As you wish. Someone else, then…
jei.tears-of-ink.info.hope_essence: Reward for the Soul Trader's special order — slay a maddened hunter (Seasoned 1, Legendary 2). The Trader turns 3 essences into a Mote of Hope.
harvest.tears-of-ink.keeper_hello: Blood calls the brave. What do you seek at the Gates?
harvest.tears-of-ink.cooldown: The Gates rest. Return in %s min.
harvest.tears-of-ink.gathering: Gathering: %s of %s slots. The Gates open in %s s.
harvest.tears-of-ink.announce: The Crimson Harvest begins soon! All hunters who would test themselves and honour the tradition may take part (%s). The Ancient Gates open in %s min.
harvest.tears-of-ink.not_lands: You can travel to the Arena only from the Ink Lands.
harvest.tears-of-ink.skipped: No one came to the Crimson Harvest. The Gates stayed shut.
harvest.tears-of-ink.closed: The Arena is sealed. The Gates open in %s s — get ready.
harvest.tears-of-ink.door: The Gates open: %s enters the Arena!
harvest.tears-of-ink.fallen: You fell — the Herald carried you beyond the wall. Your belongings are with you.
harvest.tears-of-ink.won: The Crimson Harvest is won! A Gift awaits you at the Keeper.
harvest.tears-of-ink.won_best: The Crimson Harvest is won, and you fought best of all: two Gifts await you at the Keeper.
harvest.tears-of-ink.no_gift: You never crossed blades with the foe — no Gift.
harvest.tears-of-ink.over_won: The Crimson Harvest is over: the brave prevailed.
harvest.tears-of-ink.over_lost: The Crimson Harvest is over: the Arena belongs to the foe.
harvest.tears-of-ink.gift_best: Lesser Gift — for the best fighter
jei.tears-of-ink.info.crimson_gift: Reward of the Crimson Harvest (the Arena in the largest Bloodwood). Use to open. Blood clots, Pigment, blood metal, sometimes a Crimson Flower and a Blood Crystal; the harder the Harvest, the richer.
